About

Kidney care that looks at the whole patient

Dr. Chetan Kumar Veeramaneni is a consultant nephrologist and kidney transplant physician. His clinical work includes acute and chronic kidney disease, dialysis, and transplant assessment and follow-up. He also evaluates kidney complications related to diabetes and high blood pressure.

Personal website · STAR Hospitals profile

Areas of expertise

  • Chronic & acute kidney disease
  • Diabetic kidney disease
  • Primary & secondary hypertension
  • Glomerular disease
  • Electrolyte & acid–base disorders
  • Critical care nephrology
  • Paediatric kidney disease

Dialysis & transplant

  • Haemodialysis, HDF & home HD
  • Peritoneal dialysis: CAPD & APD
  • Continuous renal replacement therapy (CRRT)
  • Transplant workup for living and deceased donor options
  • ABO-incompatible and sensitized transplant cases
  • Adult and paediatric transplant follow-up

Procedures

  • Image-guided kidney biopsy
  • Tunnelled & non-tunnelled dialysis catheters
  • Rigid and soft-cuffed peritoneal dialysis catheters
  • AV fistula cannulation and dialysis access procedures
